description: Test cases for BST-related tutoring scenarios

test_cases.student_query: How do I check if a binary tree is a valid BST?
test_cases.student_work: Drew a tree with some nodes, wrote: check left < root < right for each node

expected_ai_behavior.interpretation: Student understands basic BST property but missing range constraints
expected_ai_behavior.pedagogical_approach: Build on their correct understanding, introduce range concept

success_criteria: AI recognizes partial correctness of approach
AI introduces range/bounds concept without full solution
AI asks guiding questions about edge cases

test_cases.student_query: I'm stuck on inserting into BST recursively
test_cases.student_work: Started recursive function but confused about base case and return values

expected_ai_behavior.interpretation: Student needs help with recursive thinking and tree modification
expected_ai_behavior.hint_level: Level 1 - Gentle nudge about what happens when we find null

success_criteria: AI asks about base case understanding
AI connects to general recursion patterns
AI doesn't give away the implementation

test_cases.student_query: My BST search function never terminates
test_cases.student_work: Code with infinite loop in search function

expected_ai_behavior.interpretation: Debugging help needed - guide through systematic debugging

success_criteria: AI helps student trace through execution
AI teaches debugging technique, not just fix

test_cases.student_query: Can you show me the complete solution for BST deletion?
test_cases.student_work: Attempted deletion but handled only simple cases

expected_ai_behavior.interpretation: Student ready for complete solution with educational focus
expected_ai_behavior.pedagogical_approach: Acknowledge attempt, explain complex cases systematically

success_criteria: AI breaks down three deletion cases clearly
AI connects to broader algorithmic patterns

evaluation_metrics.response_appropriateness: Does AI response match expected behavior for student's level?
evaluation_metrics.pedagogical_soundness: Does response promote learning vs just giving answers?
evaluation_metrics.hint_progression: Does AI start with appropriate hint level?

common_failure_patterns: AI gives full solution when hint would suffice
AI doesn't recognize student's partial understanding
AI uses overly technical language for beginner
AI doesn't connect to student's existing work
